One-liner: A test suite for the rules your community writes in plain English: add scenarios, validators decide, and a gap earns a bounty.
Description: Dryrun is a test suite for plain-language rules on GenLayer. An owner registers a rule set and funds a bounty pool. Anyone adds scenarios with the answer they expect, ALLOW or BLOCK, and a stake. Validators label each scenario ALLOW, BLOCK or UNCLEAR under the rules and must agree on that one label. The contract computes PASS, FAIL or UNCLEAR for each case and a GREEN, AMBER or RED suite, never the model. A scenario that exposes a gap earns its author a bounty. Updating the rules turns every case STALE until it runs again. Live on Studio Next, with golden scenarios run through real consensus and published as they came out, misses included.
Step 1: Open https://dryrun-genlayer.vercel.app/r, select Connect wallet, then Switch network and Get test GEN. Under Register a rule set type a name and the rules, then select $ dryrun register and confirm. On the suite page type an amount and select $ dryrun fund. Or skip this and use any suite in the list.
Step 2: Open a suite and select $ dryrun add --rules. Type a scenario, for example A member shares a podcast they appeared on in the main channel, pick ALLOW or BLOCK, then select run it, 1 GEN and confirm both transactions.
Step 3: The page shows validators reading, then the bracketed result: [PASS], [FAIL] or [UNCL]. The suite page shows the bar and the colour GREEN, AMBER or RED. An UNCLEAR case credits the bounty to its author.
Step 4: As the owner, edit the text under dryrun update-rules and select $ dryrun update-rules. Every case turns [STALE]. Select $ dryrun run --stale on each case and the suite colour is computed again.
Step 5: Open my cases, from the rail link bounties, and select $ dryrun withdraw to take back your stakes and any bounty you earned.
Proof: Walked on the live site from three fresh accounts: register_rules, fund_pool, a clear case (PASS) and the spec's podcast case (UNCLEAR, 2 GEN bounty, AMBER), a new version turning both STALE, both run again to GREEN, then a withdrawal; balances match to the wei apart from one uncharged payout-message fee. Golden: 8 of 10 matched, both misses published. Held-out: H1 UNCLEAR, H2 UNCLEAR, H3 BLOCK. 60 of 60 mutants caught. A write counts only when execution_result is SUCCESS.
Steward note: Known limits: Dryrun predicts what a rule text says. It does not enforce rules, judge fairness or replace a human ruling, and a GREEN suite is only as good as its scenarios. Only the label is stored, not the reason. The spec has no way to take a pool back, so it leaves only as bounties. An empty suite and a case that has not run keep a suite AMBER. The runtime header is the GenVM v0.4 runner the live network now requires. Rule sets are public.
